title: The Iliad: Trojans
description: Priam’s family, the defenders of Troy, and their allies.

pairs.q: *Trojan.* Eldest son of Priam and Hekabe, husband of Andromache, the chief defender of the city.
*Trojan.* Aged king of Troy; he comes by night to ransom his son's body and kisses the hands of Achilleus.
*Trojan.* Queen of Troy; she leads the women's offering of a robe to Athene and begs her son from the wall to come inside.
*Trojan.* Infant son of Hektor, frightened by the horsehair crest on his father's helmet; his father calls him Skamandrios.
*Trojan.* Son of Priam who carried off Helen; Aphrodite snatches him away from his duel with Menelaos.
*In Troy.* Daughter of Zeus and wife of Menelaos, taken from Lakedaimon; from the wall she names the Achaian leaders for Priam.
*Trojan.* Son of Anchises and Aphrodite, leader of the Dardanians; one of the only Trojans to survive the war; Poseidon rescues him from Achilleus.
*Trojan.* A spy who goes out at night in a wolfskin; Odysseus and Diomedes catch and kill him.
*Trojan ally.* Son of Zeus and leader of the Lykians, killed by Patroklos; Sleep and Death carry his body home.
